findings.issue: BroadcastAuthController reads Reverb credentials instead of Pusher
findings.description: The generateChannelAuth method must read PUSHER_APP_KEY and PUSHER_APP_SECRET from config('broadcasting.connections.pusher.*') instead of reverb. All channel authorization will fail in production.
Verify that Reverb parameters (wsHost, wsPort, wssPort, enabledTransports) are not present in the echo.ts Echo constructor.

findings.issue: render.yaml PUSHER_APP_SECRET not marked as sync: false
findings.description: The PUSHER_APP_SECRET value is an empty string with sync: false, which is correct, but verify in Render that the secret is set as a non-synced variable in the dashboard.
